title: Scrolling horizontally and vertically on a grid pager work in an unexpected way
line: Scrolling sideways over a pager with several rows now stays in the current row instead of jumping to the next one.
explanation: The pager's wheel handler took the vertical or horizontal delta and stepped linearly through the whole desktop list, so on a grid a sideways scroll from the end of one row moved to the start of the next, even with "Navigation wraps around" off. The change makes horizontal scrolling work only within the current row (clamped, or wrapping inside the row when wrap-around is on). Vertical scrolling keeps stepping through every desktop, so a plain mouse wheel can still reach all of them.

commits.message:
applets/pager: Keep horizontal scrolling within the current row

On a pager with several rows, scrolling sideways stepped through all
desktops and jumped to the next row, even with wrapping off. Keep it in
the current row; vertical scrolling still reaches every desktop.

BUG: 471160

media.caption: 4 desktops in 2 rows, wrap-around off: on desktop 2 one notch of horizontal scroll to the right jumps to desktop 3 in the next row.
Same notch with the fix: it stays on desktop 2, the end of its row.
